links.outcome: Top-1 accuracy of LLM variants versus classical baselines on same synthetic data
links.effect: Classical baselines reached 0.567 top-1; pure LLM variants reached 0.267 to 0.467; Sonnet to Opus backbone did not help.
links.quote: On an apples-to-apples synthetic evaluation, classical baselines reach 0.567 top-1 while pure LLM variants trail at 0.267 to 0.467, and moving the backbone from Sonnet to Opus does not help.

unlisted_practices: Split-conformal selective prediction with abstain flag for next-procedure recommendation

screen.reason: Evaluates a clinical next-procedure recommender combining classical models and LLMs, specifically testing and incorporating selective prediction/abstention flags and conformal calibration as safeguards.
